exemptions: Children under 2 on departure day; transit/transfer passengers continuing on another flight within 24 hours; airline crew on duty.
legal_basis: Lov nr. 620 af 11. juni 2024 om passagerafgift på flyrejser, § 3 (L 184, 2023-24); political agreement 'Grøn luftfart i Danmark' (Dec 2023)

instrument: taxa de carbono sobre viagens aéreas (carbon tax on air travel)
band_definition: All passengers departing on commercial flights from airports/aerodromes in Portuguese territory
exemptions: Children under 2; air transport of residents of the Autonomous Regions (Azores, Madeira) between mainland and the region and within the region; public passenger transport exemptions per Portaria.
legal_basis: Lei n.º 75-B/2020 de 31 de dezembro (OE 2021), art. 390; Portaria n.º 38/2021 de 16 de fevereiro
notes: Flat EUR 2 per passenger, charged at ticket issuance; also applies to maritime passenger travel. No distance bands.

instrument: taxa de carbono sobre viagens aéreas (carbon tax on air travel) - extension to private/non-commercial aviation
band_definition: Passengers on non-commercial / private flights in aircraft with up to 19 seats departing Portugal
exemptions: Children under 2; air transport of residents of the Autonomous Regions (Azores, Madeira) between mainland and the region and within the region; public passenger transport exemptions per Portaria.
legal_basis: Portaria n.º 110/2023 (amending Portaria n.º 38/2021)
notes: Scope extension only; rate unchanged at EUR 2.

instrument: taxe sur l'embarquement dans un aéronef / inschepingstaks (embarkation tax)
band_definition: Final destination less than 500 km from Brussels Airport (BRU/EBBR)
exemptions: Infants (under 2); active and repositioning flight crew; transit and transfer passengers; departures following forced landings (weather/force majeure); certain state/military flights.
legal_basis: Loi du 28 mars 2022 portant réduction de charges sur le travail (M.B. 31-03-2022), provisions on the 'taxe sur l'embarquement dans un aéronef' / 'inschepingstaks'
notes: Due by air carriers per departing passenger from a Belgian airport (commercial and non-commercial fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft). 2025 federal coalition discussed restructuring to a flat rate (reported ~EUR 5); not verified as enacted - check before extending series beyond 2025.

instrument: taxe sur l'embarquement dans un aéronef / inschepingstaks (embarkation tax)
band_definition: Final destination 500 km or more from BRU and within EEA, UK or Switzerland
exemptions: Infants (under 2); active and repositioning flight crew; transit and transfer passengers; departures following forced landings (weather/force majeure); certain state/military flights.
legal_basis: Loi du 28 mars 2022 portant réduction de charges sur le travail (M.B. 31-03-2022), provisions on the 'taxe sur l'embarquement dans un aéronef' / 'inschepingstaks'
notes: Due by air carriers per departing passenger from a Belgian airport (commercial and non-commercial fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft). 2025 federal coalition discussed restructuring to a flat rate (reported ~EUR 5); not verified as enacted - check before extending series beyond 2025.

instrument: taxe sur l'embarquement dans un aéronef / inschepingstaks (embarkation tax)
band_definition: Final destination outside EEA, UK and Switzerland (>=500 km)

instrument: addizionale comunale sui diritti d'imbarco (municipal surcharge on passenger boarding fees)
band_definition: All passengers boarding at Italian airports (national rate, no distance differentiation)
exemptions: Follows the rules of the airport boarding fee (diritti d'imbarco) to which it is a surcharge; infants under 2 and transit passengers are generally not charged - not verified from the sources consulted.
legal_basis: Legge 24 dicembre 2003, n. 350 (Finanziaria 2004), art. 2, c. 11
notes: Introduced at EUR 1 from 2004 ('noise tax' compensating airport municipalities). End date = eve of 2005 increase (see next row note).

instrument: addizionale commissariale Roma Capitale sui diritti d'imbarco (extra surcharge, Rome airports)
band_definition: Passengers departing from (and transiting at) Rome Fiumicino and Ciampino - added on top of the national surcharge
exemptions: Follows the rules of the airport boarding fee (diritti d'imbarco) to which it is a surcharge; infants under 2 and transit passengers are generally not charged - not verified from the sources consulted.
legal_basis: D.L. 31 maggio 2010, n. 78, art. 14, c. 14 (conv. L. 122/2010) - up to EUR 1 per passenger for Roma Capitale debt
notes: Makes Rome total EUR 7.50 (since 1 July 2013). Exact start date of collection not verified (decree date used).

band_definition: Destination airport not more than 300 km from Dublin Airport (Ireland, UK west/north)
exemptions: Children under 2; transit and transfer passengers; flight crew; departures from airports with fewer than 10,000 departing passengers in the previous year (verify in Finance (No. 2) Act 2008 s. 55).
legal_basis: Finance (No. 2) Act 2008, s. 55
notes: Two-tier rate; EU Commission found the distance differentiation incompatible with internal-market rules (also State-aid recovery case vs Aer Lingus/Ryanair).

band_definition: Destination airport more than 300 km from Dublin Airport
exemptions: Children under 2; transit and transfer passengers; flight crew; departures from airports with fewer than 10,000 departing passengers in the previous year (verify in Finance (No. 2) Act 2008 s. 55).
legal_basis: Finance (No. 2) Act 2008, s. 55

band_definition: All departures (single rate)
exemptions: Children under 2; transit and transfer passengers; flight crew; departures from airports with fewer than 10,000 departing passengers in the previous year (verify in Finance (No. 2) Act 2008 s. 55).
legal_basis: Finance Act 2011 (amending Finance (No. 2) Act 2008 s. 55)
notes: Flat EUR 3 from 1 March 2011.

band_definition: All departures
legal_basis: Air Travel Tax (Abolition) Order 2014, S.I. No. 130 of 2014 (announced Budget 2014, Oct 2013)
notes: Rate set to zero / provisions cease to apply to departures on or after 1 April 2014.

band_definition: All passengers departing Malta International Airport
exemptions: Not verified.
legal_basis: Maltese departure-tax regulations (Lm 10 = EUR 23.29); removed by Legal Notice effective 1 Nov 2008 after EU Commission infringement proceedings (decision to refer to ECJ 27 June 2007)
notes: Introduction date not established from sources consulted (tax long pre-dated 2008). Abolished 1 Nov 2008.

band_definition: All departures
legal_basis: Legal Notice removing departure tax, effective 1 Nov 2008
notes: No Maltese ticket tax since.

band_definition: Departing passengers (over 5 years) with final destination in EU/Schengen countries incl. domestic
exemptions: Children up to 5 years (pre-2017).
legal_basis: Law 2065/1992, art. 40 (Airport Development Fund / 'spatosimo'), as amended by Law 2892/2001 and Law 4465/2017 art. 52
notes: Quasi-fiscal earmarked charge (airport infrastructure fund), not classified as a ticket tax in CE Delft 2019. Start date of the EUR 12/22 structure (post-2001 euro conversion) not verified. A revision on 31 Oct 2014 lowered fees for some flights - new amounts not confirmed.

band_definition: Departing passengers with final destination outside EU/Schengen
exemptions: Children up to 5 years (pre-2017).
legal_basis: Law 2065/1992, art. 40 (Airport Development Fund / 'spatosimo'), as amended by Law 2892/2001 and Law 4465/2017 art. 52
notes: Sources disagree: gtp.gr 2014 article gives EUR 24 for non-EU, gtp.gr 2017 gives EUR 22 for non-Schengen. Treat as uncertain.

band_definition: All departing passengers over 2 years from all Greek airports (single rate)
exemptions: Children under 2 (age threshold lowered from 5 to 2 in 2017).
legal_basis: Law 2065/1992, art. 40 (Airport Development Fund / 'spatosimo'), as amended by Law 2892/2001 and Law 4465/2017 art. 52
notes: Flat EUR 12 from the start of the Fraport Greece regional-airport concession (11 April 2017) until 1 Nov 2024 per Law 4465/2017 art. 52; start date inferred from concession start.

band_definition: All departing passengers over 2 years from all Greek airports (single rate)
exemptions: Children under 2.
legal_basis: Law 2065/1992, art. 40 (Airport Development Fund / 'spatosimo'), as amended by Law 2892/2001 and Law 4465/2017 art. 52
notes: Reduced 75% from EUR 12 to EUR 3 on 1 Nov 2024 as scheduled by Law 4465/2017 art. 52 (Athens Airport simultaneously raised its own PTF charge).

instrument: none (no national air passenger ticket tax)
legal_basis: n/a
notes: Only airport charges (AENA) apply. A 2022 expert committee on tax reform proposed a EUR 7.85/passenger environmental ticket tax - not enacted.

instrument: none (flight ticket levy rejected by referendum)
legal_basis: Revised CO2 Act (Federal Act on the Reduction of Greenhouse Gas Emissions) - proposed ticket levy CHF 30-120 by distance/class - rejected in referendum of 13 June 2021 (51.6% No)
notes: No Swiss ticket tax in force.
